---
title: "Outside readings"
---

These public texts are part of the course, not an afterthought. Commercial textbook chapters are not listed here.

- [Declaration of Independence](https://www.archives.gov/founding-docs/declaration-transcript)
- [U.S. Constitution](https://www.archives.gov/founding-docs/constitution-transcript)
- [Bill of Rights](https://www.archives.gov/founding-docs/bill-of-rights-transcript)
- [Federalist No. 10](https://avalon.law.yale.edu/18th_century/fed10.asp)
- [Federalist No. 51](https://avalon.law.yale.edu/18th_century/fed51.asp)
- [Brutus I](https://archive.csac.history.wisc.edu/Brutus_I.pdf)
- [Washington's Farewell Address](https://www.senate.gov/artandhistory/history/resources/pdf/Washingtons_Farewell_Address.pdf)
